adrs.title: Parallelism model: file-disjoint slices + Jev lane decisions
adrs.decision: Shared-file contention was the only thing serialising module slices, so: (1) src/app.js auto-mounts every src/routes/*.js at /<basename> (alias map for /administration) — slices never edit app.js; (2) src/db.js applies db/migrations/*.sql in filename order inside the schema transaction — each slice owns one idempotent file. Module slices are therefore code-independent; remaining dependencies in the registry are DATA dependencies only (S7 needs S6 scores, S8 needs S2+S5 data, S10 needs S2 records). Lane choice is a Jev decision via codemode (one call, atomic questions); all five current slices scored parallel_safe 0.85 and needs_heavy_lane < 0.6 -> flash-fleet x5 concurrently.
evidence: all 11 routes verified 200 after the refactor
